observations: Photo 0 shows a black Xbox console with visible scratches and scuffs on the front panel. The Xbox logo is visible on the lower left.
Photo 1 shows the front of the console from a top-down angle, with the same scratches and scuffs. The top left corner has the Xbox logo.
Photo 2 shows the back of the console with a label that includes 'XBOX ONE CONSOLE', 'SN: 22004534', and other specifications. The label is slightly worn and has some smudges.
All photos have a watermark 'POSTED ON JIJI ODIKA UZOR'.

claims.claim: Fairly used Xbox One in very good condition
claims.evidence: Photos show visible scratches and scuffs, but no functional test or internal inspection is possible remotely. The condition is subjective and not fully verifiable from photos alone.
No screen or interface is shown to verify installed games. The console's internal storage and game library cannot be accessed remotely.
No controllers or power pack are visible in any photo. The seller's claim cannot be confirmed or denied from the images.

risks.risk: Console may not power on or may have internal damage
risks.proof: A video showing the console powering on, booting up, and displaying the Xbox dashboard.

risks.risk: Games may be corrupted or not installed properly
risks.proof: A screenshot or video showing the installed games list on the console's dashboard.

risks.risk: Controllers and power pack may be missing or damaged
risks.proof: Photos of the controllers and power pack, showing their condition and presence.

risks.risk: Console may have hardware issues (e.g., disc drive, HDMI, power supply)
risks.proof: A video showing the console connecting to a TV, playing a game, and using the disc drive.

proof_requests: Video of the console powering on and booting up.
Screenshot or video of the installed games list.
Photos of the controllers and power pack.
Video showing the console connecting to a TV and playing a game.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
